notes: The theme this app added yesterday is called ColorOS now, and it is the first thing in its group with a NEW tag on it. It was on the wall the whole time, sitting four rows below a badge reward nobody can pick yet — which is exactly what this release fixes.

Every badge theme has moved to its own group at the bottom of the list, so all the free themes come first, in one line, with nothing locked in between. The rewards still say what they cost and still unlock the same way; they are just out of the way until you have the badges.

ColorOS is recoloured to what ColorOS actually looks like: deep teal-black, a mint accent, aqua behind it, and a curtain of two soft pools drifting for twenty seconds. Same key underneath, so a phone that already picked it keeps its pick.

Each row in the wall now shows the theme itself — a chip of its background, its accent and its second accent — instead of a single dot of one colour. Two themes with the same accent no longer look identical.

Opening a group staggers its rows in, 14ms apart, and picking a theme settles the sheet instead of snapping to a repainted screen. Both read the motion the app already had; both stop dead when Reduce motion is on.

The widget has six bright presets — Bubblegum, Mint, Sunshine, Sky, Tangerine, Grape — with dark text on light gradients, listed first, and a fresh install starts on Bubblegum. The twelve dark ones are all still there with their colours and their saved picks.
